steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So according to you, that Duke Caster has had her spies embedded in Kjerag for a long, long time. And it's all to prepare for a future annexation?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But how is she going to do that?

steps.name: Victorian Reporter
steps.text: To be more precise... this is my educated guess based on what I've learned in Kjerag.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So out of all the Victorians sneaking around Kjerag, you happen to be the only actual reporter who's after truth and righteousness and suchlike?

spans.text: So out of all the Victorians sneaking around Kjerag, you happen to be the only
reporter who's after truth and righteousness and suchlike?

steps.name: Victorian Reporter
steps.text: Well, you don't have to be so rude about it!

steps.name: Victorian Reporter
steps.text: My name's Alberta. If you're familiar with the Victorian newsprint business, you would've heard that name in conjunction with many articles about the truth that were deemed 'unprintable'.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I take pride in my work, no matter what they say.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'll believe you for now, little Miss Reporter, but this doesn't mean you're completely free of suspicion.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I've had my guards rip out the spies your people sent after the explosion.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If you're telling the truth, then take us to your crew's station. I've got a lot of things I'd like to ask the agents you mentioned.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Move!
Degenbrecher grabs Ratatos and the reporter, pulling them into the back room as a stun grenade from who-knows-where goes off in the interrogation room.
In the distance, a Browntail guard who was unable to get out of the way in time screams. A throwing knife has pierced his heart.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Dammit!
Degenbrecher pokes her body out the doorway, hiding back behind the door as another knife flies towards her. She watches it tremble after it embeds itself in the door frame.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: These knives are the ones used by the Trilby Ashers.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You two stay hidden here. I'll go confirm the scale of the raid and their strategy.

As she finishes speaking, she suddenly draws her twin weapons, knocking two knives thrown from the shadows out of the air before springing forward to attack. The dust she kicks up forces the reporter to squint.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What the hell's going on? How do the Trilby Ashers know about this place?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Did you leak it to them? But I've been watching you the whole time, that can't be...

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I didn't! I even checked over all my things, and made sure nobody was following me.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: Look out!
The room shakes violently. The reporter pulls at Ratatos's sleeve, moving her to the other side of the room as fragments of the damaged ceiling smash into the floor where they just were.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Then how do you explain all this?

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: ...Wait! There's still one place I haven't checked.
She picks up the camera hanging around her neck, removes the lens, presses down on the shutter, and lifts up the reflector. A faint red light glows within.
She pulls out the suspicious component. A miniature tracking device.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: So that's where it was hiding...
Another explosion, and thick smoke slowly seeps into the room the two are hiding in. Degenbrecher emerges from the smoke, her breathing somewhat ragged.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Three Trilby Ashers with this first group. I fended them off for now, but the reinforcements they called for are already on their way here.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I will keep you safe, Ratatos, but we need to leave.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Let's go to the Vine-Bead Court. There's a mountain trail nearby that leads to one of the secret passages in.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: They won't dare act rashly against the Court. It'll buy us some time.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: Wait, I need to come with you.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: Since the Trilby Ashers will keep chasing us, I'll make a record of all their assassination attempts in Kjerag and compile them together with everything they've done so far. I'll pass them to a local friend to get the word out.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: This will expose all of Victoria's dirty deeds to the public.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I can't let myself be taken in by them!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enough babbling, I still need to find Enciodes for a joint questioning.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You'd be coming with us even if you didn't want to.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: ...Yes, Ratatos is alive. The three of them have entered the Vine-Bead Court's northern gate.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: The escaped reporter is with her, and the renowned Black Knight is guarding them.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: What orders from Her Grace?

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: ...Wait.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: ...Did you just say that Her Grace will personally be visiting Kjerag?

a.text: and to Enciodes Silverash, son of the former Chairman and my kinswoman Elizabeth
alongside all the people of Kjerag:
This is an open letter, within which is written all the wrongdoings of Enciodes and Karlan Trade both.
With this letter I shall formally protest, protest all the grievances that Victoria and Kjerag share in suffering from, that were wholly avoidable.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: Chairman Edelweiss! I'm glad you're here!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What is it? Slow down.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: I-It's a letter by the Duke of Caster. The contents have already been disseminated to the public.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: It's all about Kjerag... Mostly Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What did she write?

steps.name: Karlan Trade Employee
steps.text: About how we're not acting in good faith, and Sir Enciodes—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Give it here.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Notify all members of the Board that we are to have an immediate meeting at HQ.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Tell everyone to remain calm.

a.text: Enciodes's first offense, and the source of all this tragedy, was to seek benefit from Columbia, brute-forcing the carving-out of a great pit and the construction of an observation station atop Mount Karlan.
In the wake of it, Catastrophe descended on Kjerag. This much is undeniable.
Amidst the terror and disarray, he committed his second offense. The humanitarian aid sent by Victoria was instead pocketed by him in the name of negotiation.
To legitimize this shameless act, Enciodes went on the attack against Victoria, leveling baseless accusations and slander against Victorian tourists and expatriates. This was his third offense.

His ultimate act of toying with the heart of the public was also his fourth offense. He colluded with Ratatos to fake the Browntail matriarch's death, and through duplicity, lead Clan Browntail into hostilities with Victoria.

steps.name: Doubtful Local
steps.text: '...Victoria also has proof that Ratatos is hidden within the Vine-Bead Court. Those citizens who doubt this simply need examine the premises, though his guilty heart has led him to station his private army there.'

steps.name: Doubtful Local
steps.text: This is... all a bit much.

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: Hey, when I was suspicious of Enciodes earlier, you guys shouted me down like I was a conspiracy theorist. But it all makes sense now, doesn't it?

steps.name: Determined Local
steps.text: Since when? The whole letter's just Victoria's say-so.

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: The fifth offense explained it, didn't it? Enciodes told Ratatos to kidnap that Victorian reporter and hid her in the Court. Can't be a lie with all those details, can it?

steps.name: Doubtful Local
steps.text: And the sixth offense says in order to control the Court, he arrested all the clerics who wouldn't obey him. That matches.

steps.name: Doubtful Local
steps.text: The Court invited us all up the mountain for blessings, but Degenbrecher had some men stop us.

steps.name: Determined Local
steps.text: What about the seventh, then? It's obvious that Victoria wanted to get a bigger slice of the pie, but Karlan Trade refused them.

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: You're a real idiot, you know that? It's proof that Enciodes has gone and betrayed Kjerag.

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: Victoria's made a fair point about Karlan Trade going against all their contracts, and now we're the ones stuck with the bill thanks to Enciodes's stupid decisions!

steps.name: Determined Local
steps.text: So you think we should do what Victoria says? They want Karlan Trade to stick with the old mining agreement, and put Enciodes on trial!

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: They said they'd do a joint trial with the Vine-Bead Court, it'll be fine. Enciodes would be lucky if he just got banished for his crimes.

steps.name: Determined Local
steps.text: The only crime he's done is letting you run your mouth in this rebuilt pub!

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: So he's been doing all the good, while it's always someone else doing the sinning? Wow, what a coincidence!

steps.name: Doubtful Local
steps.text: ...I don't understand any of this, but I know it's always us who have to suffer for it.

steps.name: Determined Local
steps.text: C'mon man, trust in Sir Enciodes, he's helped me out before—

steps.name: Discontent Local
steps.text: What the hell was that?

steps.name: Barkeeper
steps.text: O-Outside...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I heard a lot of troubling talk on the way here.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Please tell me you've been doing more than admiring the snow.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I shouldn't have asked.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Is everything that happened still as you expected?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...If I said yes, would you believe me?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I would.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Because we're not unprepared. During the recent growth window, Karlan Trade—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am afraid it is you who is the optimistic one this time, Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You know that, no matter how many plans and contingencies we make, things will inevitably exceed our expectations.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: From the three clans, the Vine-Bead Court, and stretching out to all the people of Kjerag, Victoria's methods are plain to see.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As someone who always bets every chip he has, you were never afraid of risk.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thus, all this is all I deserve.
Dark clouds cover the twilight sky. The steel behemoths of Victoria trample across the white snowfields.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Caster's fleet...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've heard this fleet was the one that drove the devils out of Victoria during the Battle of Londinium.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After the battle concluded, Caster took the time to restore its flagship, so that her Glory may live on.

spans.text: After the battle concluded, Caster took the time to restore its flagship, so that her

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How many upon this great land can boast of the might to stand against this force?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...We chose to walk the more difficult road. It is time we meet the end of it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whew—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why are all of Kjerag's mountains so hard to climb...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Just bear it a little longer, Elena. We need to avoid the Vine-Bead Court, and this is the only road that does so.
A Rift Cloudbeast clambers up onto Elena's shoulder out of nowhere before jumping back into Joanna's embrace, letting out a high-pitched cry.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Heh, it's laughing at you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Laugh all you want... I've done more exercise today then the past twenty-something years I've been alive...
Enya looks at the crestfallen Elena, letting out a light chuckle as she turns the corner.
She sees a simple camp by the side of the road, not far from where they stand.
There are many clerics of the Vine-Bead Court warming themselves by the fire. Amidst the crowd, Enya picks out a familiar figure with but a glance.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Why'd you stop, Enya?

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...Is that Elder Adso?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I didn't think... I would run into you here.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Because you should not be here, Saintess.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: You know, Elder, when you're talking with the Saintess, you should be more—

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I know, and yet I also know this is not the road she is meant to be on.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...What if it is to search for Kjeragandr?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: All shall seek Her in their time of need.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: So, what is it you need?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You instructed me to go on the Pilgrimage, so that I may atone for the sins of all Kjerag to Her. Thus, what I need is to find Her, and pray to Her for forgiveness.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I had wanted to get you out of the Vine-Bead Court at the time.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...And in doing so, the Court would not be 'hindered' by me.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I had hoped that while you were off on the Pilgrimage, we would be able to sway the Duke of Caster into handling Enciodes, and that when you returned, it would be to both parties worn and wary.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: The Court would then take advantage of your return to declare a miracle, thus gaining true control.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: But your brother declared war on the Court too soon, and I could not allow myself to fall into the hands of Caster or Enciodes, whether as their prisoner, or as their puppet.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I presume you being here means you are thinking of being like the Court clerics of old, going to Karlan to the ancient refuges in the legends, where you can wait for the moment your enemies are 'worn'.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: As such, there is no need for you to continue with your meaningless circuit, Saintess. Follow us to seek refuge atop the mountains.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: There will come a time that the people will beg on bended knee for you, and us, to appear.
The silent elders of the Court behind him stand up one after the other, forming a semicircle before the Saintess.
Joanna glances at Enya with unease, her hand subconsciously moving towards her crossbow, but Enya merely gives her a light shake of the head.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I can't stop. The next Catastrophe is nearly upon us.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The Saintess is right, Elder. You must have noticed the strange weather these past few days.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We've already found an important clue about the 'Heart of Karlan'. We have the opportunity to learn the exact reason why a Catastrophe came to strike Kjerag.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Maybe even... the truth behind Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...It is meaningless.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Elder—

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Because Kjeragandr does not exist.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: ...What did you say?!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: When I left the Court, you told me quite the opposite.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Kjeragandr' can exist within the plants, the stones, our words and deeds, but you will not find Her true form atop this great land.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: She is not real, only existing within our imaginations.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: Not even you can blaspheme against Her, Elder Adso!

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...When I was young, my faith in Her was much the same as yours. My father and uncle sent me to the Vine-Bead Court as a child, forcing me to secretly aid Clan Browntail with their mission, yet all I wanted to do was to serve Her in all sincerity.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: When the Great Elder tasked me with managing the Hall of Writings, I was giddy with glee. Every word to do with Her, whether they be fragmented pages or ridiculous essays, were studied by me over and over.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: But the more you read, the more you realize that the so-called Kjeragandr is nothing more than a piece of 'scripture' assembled by mortal men.

spans.text: But the more you read, the more you realize that the so-called
is nothing more than a piece of 'scripture' assembled by mortal men.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Dare you deny it, Saintess? You too have seen what is said to be the original copy. It is no more than a few scant phrases, nothing like what we have today.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: It's not true, is it, Enya...?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: From marketplace chatter to historical records, even foreign legends from who-knows-where. Add cold gales and snowy peaks, and you have the 'miracles' of Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I persisted in my inspection of everything, hoping to find even the tiniest shred of evidence 'unlike the rest'. But all I found were more and more archetypical tales.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: I even found signs of adaptation left behind by previous Court elders in the margins of a few books.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...Why didn't you tell anyone?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: And what would I say?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: What is Kjerag to you, Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That is not a question any one child of Kjerag can answer.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Because Kjerag already has its answer. This is a nation of faith.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Enciodes has tried to undermine it, the Duke of Caster has tried to swallow it, but even they dare not defy Kjeragandr, at least not openly.

steps.name: Joanna
steps.text: But if She doesn't exist, then who founded Kjerag?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...Our country was never one built atop Her flesh and bones. Rather, it was Her country that was built atop our flesh, our bones.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: It was the ancestors of the people of Kjerag who, amidst these snow-capped mountains of despair, labored tortuously to create a place where they could survive.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: People could never understand why fate decreed they should struggle in suffering, whilst others thrived in merriment.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: And so, abandoned upon these hopeless rocks, they had to seek consolation elsewhere, so that they may continue to live.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: From the cries for some almighty leader and the prayers for majesty and morality of every generation of Kjerag, 'Kjeragandr' was born.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: From the moment of Her birth, She became the foundation of Kjerag. Because of their need for faith, generation after generation must repeat a lie.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Kjerag needed virtue and law, needed art and aesthetics, needed family and tradition. With 'perfect timing', She would appear by our sides, leaving behind a few revelatory words of wisdom.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: From this came an unbreakable order, one that has lasted time immemorial.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: So in your eyes, this lie must be maintained at any cost, so that Kjerag itself can be maintained.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Every nation has its own lie. Kjerag's is 'Kjeragandr'.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I disagree.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A lie can bring temporary reprieve, but it cannot become the eternal law through which we live.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You believe it is able to maintain order, so you care not for the sincere longing of the people. You treat their feelings as a tool you can control.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: When this longing tears through the veil you have constructed, the Vine-Bead Court and the faith it tends to shall be shattered beyond repair.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: From that point of view, you are your hated Enciodes's greatest ally.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: There is only one thing I wish to ask you. Do you believe Kjeragandr exists?

spans.text: There is only one thing I wish to ask you. Do

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I... but...
She sifts through her mind, through all her memories of that head maid... but she has already forgotten. How she looked, vague wisps of emotion, all forgotten.
There is no memory, no person who can vouch for her, no-one who can offer her words of comfort. Her heart lies empty...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I do.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You claim this is all a lie, Elder Adso, which is proof that there is a truth to correspond with this lie.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And so I believe in the passion and goodness preached by the scriptures. I believe Kjeragandr exists in Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Besides, I have already found the path to Her.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If you must refute me, then come witness alongside me.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Your 'faith' is pointless, Saintess. Even greater disaster awaits Kjerag.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Enciodes's short-sightedness has already left her faith on the brink of collapse. This is our last chance to save her.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Ever since the Pilgrimage began, you have treated me as part of your conspiracy.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Because we have both dedicated our entire lives to the faith. It is impossible for you to not understand my devotion.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Then what is it you wish me to do?

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: At a suitable hour, return with me to the Vine-Bead Court to regain control.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: We shall have to look at our specific circumstances to deal with the Duke of Caster, but Enciodes must be eliminated.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: You are a kind soul, and cannot bear to harm your brother. I understand.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Enciodes must leave Kjerag. That is the most we can allow him.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is pure coercion.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: In return, I can take you to the place you seek.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: When I was young, I had searched all of Karlan. Since you must face the truth, this will be the quickest way to do it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I accept.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Enya?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But on one condition. If we really do find proof of Kjeragandr, you shall renounce all your schemes regarding Enciodes.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: 'Kjeragandr' above, witness our vows.
